agent_explanation: Thin wall (h=0.4) with high-speed body (~58 m/s) in semi-implicit Euler. At step 12 body is 0.014m from surface, next substep integration moves it deep enough to penetrate 0.1526m beyond 0.15 limit. Substep count (9) is insufficient for speed/wall thickness. Reducing dt to achieve same physical time with finer integration avoids penetration, indicating collision detection/missed contact between substeps or insufficient positional correction for fast corner grazing (body y ~2.87 near top of wall y=2.6).
